CreateInstanceSnapshot.instanceId: Instance ID, supporting both short ID (e.g. i-xxxxxxxx) and long UUID formats
CreateInstanceSnapshot.name: Instance snapshot name. Must start with a letter, supports uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the special characters -_ /., length 1-65
CreateInstanceSnapshot.desc: Instance snapshot description. Optional, defaults to an empty string
CreateInstanceSnapshot.volumes: List of disk IDs to include in the snapshot. Optional. If not provided, snapshots are created for the system disk and all eligible CDS data disks attached to the instance; the specified disks must be attached to the instance
CreateInstanceSnapshot.retentionInDays: Retention period of the instance snapshot. Default -1 means permanent retention, valid range is 1-10000 days
CreateInstanceSnapshot.tags.tagKey: Tag key. Can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the special characters -_ /., length 1-65
CreateInstanceSnapshot.tags.tagValue: Tag value. Can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, Chinese characters, and the special characters -_ /., length 0-65
